hooks.command: NX='let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||"")}catch(e){process.stdout.write("")}})'; f=$(node -e "$NX" | tr '\' '/'); case "$f" in *CLAUDE.md|*/.claude/*) cd 'D:/Digi Guru-Sep-2026' 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if [ -e .git/rebase-merge ] || [ -e .git/rebase-apply ] || [ -e .git/MERGE_HEAD ]; then echo '[claude-sync] a rebase/merge is already in progress - skipping pull' >&2; exit 0; fi; b=$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD); if [ -z "$b" ]; then echo '[claude-sync] detached HEAD - skipping pull' >&2; exit 0; fi; git pull origin "$b" --rebase >&2 || echo "[claude-sync] pull of $b failed (offline, no upstream, or conflict) - continuing with local state" >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

NX='let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);process.stdout.write((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||"")}catch(e){process.stdout.write("")}})'; f=$(node -e "$NX" | tr '\' '/'); case "$f" in *CLAUDE.md|*/.claude/*) cd 'D:/Digi Guru-Sep-2026' 2>/dev/null || exit 0; b=$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD); if [ -z "$b" ]; then echo '[claude-sync] detached HEAD - not committing' >&2; exit 0; fi; git add -- "$f" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if git diff --cached --quiet -- "$f"; then exit 0; fi; git commit -m "docs(claude): auto-sync $(basename \"$f\")" --quiet 2>/dev/null || true; git push origin "$b" >&2 || echo "[claude-sync] push of $b failed (offline?) - committed locally, push manually" >&2 ;; esac; exit 0
